Leah (marketing): Quick ask for launch materials — can eng-runtime run a focused bench sweep for the launch blog + webinar? We need: embeddings (short) and text-gen (chat) p50/p95, plus a warmup heatmap showing cold vs steady-state. Prefer a small reserved run so tails are stable.

Arjun (marketing): Also want estimated cost delta between fp16 and 8-bit for the same workload if possible. Even a per-1M-token rough estimate is fine.

Maya (eng-runtime): We can run that. Clarify: models to test? single model family or compare two? And sequence lengths for embeddings vs chat?

Leah (marketing): Primary model = open-curated-v1. Add an RLHF variant as a baseline if trivial. Embeddings: 64 token inputs (short). Chat: turns that produce ~200 tokens. Include streaming for chat.

Maya (eng-runtime): Good. We'll run: open-curated-v1 fp16, open-curated-v1 8bit, and rlhf-baseline fp16. We'll do cold (first request after model-load) and warm (50 repeated requests per worker). Warm pool = 4 workers reserved.

Diego (eng-ml): Please attach the eval set link so we can measure small quality deltas on the 200-token chat cases: https://internal.redwood/evals/launch-chatset-v4

Leah (marketing): Attached above. Legal wants reproducible commands + seed. Also a short methodology blurb: sample size, random seed, reserved pool config.

Maya (eng-runtime): We'll pin RNG, commit hashes, and provide run-config YAML. Quick note: autoscaler noises avoided by reserved pool. Batch size will be 4 unless you ask otherwise.

Arjun (marketing): Batch=4 ok. Can you also output a single PNG heatmap (percentile vs sequence length) we can drop into slides?

Maya (eng-runtime): Yep — PNG + CSV summary (p50/p90/p95) + raw JSONL traces. We'll measure token-level latency for streaming.

LegalBot: Reminder: include timestamped artifacts and a minimal reproducibility checklist. No competitor comparisons in the blurb.

Maya (eng-runtime): Noted. We'll include a neutral one-paragraph blurb you can customize. Draft example will be posted after numbers.

bench-bot: Job queued: bench-2026-0422-017 (priority: marketing). Estimated run time: 1.75h.

Maya (eng-runtime): Tentative window tomorrow 08:30-10:30 PT. Reserving 4 workers now. Running suites: {embed-short} x {fp16,8bit} and {chat-200} x {streaming,non} x {fp16,8bit,rlhf}. Will capture p50/p90/p95, token counts, and cost estimate.

Diego (eng-ml): We'll compute a simple quality delta (BLEU+chrF) for chat 200 token outputs.

bench-bot: Job started: bench-2026-0422-017. Artifacts will be uploaded to /artifacts/marketing/bench-2765432100 upon completion.

Maya (eng-runtime): When results are up I'll post CSV + PNG + short methodology.txt. Will also drop a small neutral blurb draft for comms.

Leah (marketing): Awesome, thanks! Please ping here with the artifact link and the 1-paragraph blurb. :rocket:
